Back of the room from left to right: the woman on the step stool, the man in the raincoat, the librarian at the desk.
Front of the room: the story corner, the two students at the table, the woman with the book cart.
Wrap-up: one sentence about the calm, cozy mood.
modelAnswer: This is Cedarbrook Public Library. Judging by the rain streaking down the big window, it's a wet, gloomy day outside. On the left, a woman with a ponytail is standing on a small step stool and stretching up to pull an orange book off a high shelf. In the middle, a man in a bright yellow raincoat seems to have just come in from the rain. He's holding a dripping umbrella, and there's a little puddle at his feet. At the front desk, a librarian in a green top is holding a purple book in one hand and a scanner in the other. In the front left corner, an older man with glasses is holding up a picture book for two kids sitting on a rug, and the little girl in pink has her hand up. At the table, one student is typing on a laptop, and another is writing in a notebook with headphones on. Finally, on the right, a woman in purple is pushing a cart full of books. All in all, it's a calm, cozy scene.

usefulExpressions.expression: Judging by…, it's a wet, gloomy day outside.
usefulExpressions.usageVi: Suy luận từ một chi tiết trong tranh (mưa trên cửa kính) — cách nói tự nhiên hơn 'I think it is raining'.

usefulExpressions.expression: …stretching up to pull … off a high shelf
usefulExpressions.usageVi: Cụm động từ mô tả động tác cụ thể: 'stretch up' (với lên), 'pull … off' (lấy … ra khỏi).

usefulExpressions.expression: …seems to have just come in from the rain
usefulExpressions.usageVi: 'seem to have + V3' để đoán một việc vừa xảy ra mà không khẳng định chắc chắn.

usefulExpressions.expression: …is holding a purple book in one hand and a scanner in the other
usefulExpressions.usageVi: Cấu trúc 'in one hand … in the other' mô tả hai tay cầm hai vật.
Cách nói ngắn gọn cho 'đang giơ tay' (thay vì 'is raising her hand up').

usefulExpressions.expression: All in all, it's a calm, cozy scene.
usefulExpressions.usageVi: Câu kết tóm tắt không khí chung của bức tranh.

commonMistakes: Nói 'a man is wearing a yellow raining coat' — đúng là 'a raincoat' (một từ).
Chỉ liệt kê 'there is a woman, there is a man' mà không có động từ -ing; mỗi người nên có một hành động: 'is stretching up', 'is typing', 'is pushing'.
Nhầm 'library' (thư viện) với 'bookstore' (hiệu sách) — tranh có tấm biển ghi rõ 'Public Library'.

review.notes: Checked every detail against the SVG markup (stool, ponytail, orange book, raincoat/umbrella/puddle, librarian's book and scanner, story corner, laptop/notebook/headphones, book cart) and the SVG rules. The orange book is on the second shelf, so "top shelf" -> "a high shelf" (answer + expression). Trimmed the model answer from 185 to ≤180 words.
